description: This file manages configuration resolution for Matrix accounts within a larger application, including functions to resolve base configs, merge account-specific settings, and check for explicit configurations.

methods.name: resolveMatrixBaseConfig
methods.description: Returns the base Matrix configuration from the core config, defaulting to an empty object if not set.

methods.name: listNormalizedMatrixAccountIds
methods.description: Lists all normalized Matrix account IDs configured in the provided core config.

methods.name: findMatrixAccountConfig
methods.description: Finds the specific Matrix account configuration for a given account ID.

methods.name: hasExplicitMatrixAccountConfig
methods.description: Checks if there is an explicit Matrix account configuration for a given account ID.

methods.name: resolveMatrixAccountConfig
methods.description: Resolves and merges the Matrix account configuration for a given account ID, considering inherited and overridden settings.
